claim: Multi-VPC private connectivity for Amazon MSK is a managed solution for multi-VPC and cross-account connectivity: clients can connect to the Amazon MSK cluster over PrivateLink while keeping all traffic within the AWS network.

evidence.quote: Multi-VPC private connectivity is a managed solution that simplifies the networking infrastructure for multi-VPC and cross-account connectivity. Clients can connect to the Amazon MSK cluster over PrivateLink while keeping all traffic within the AWS network.
